parsed.rationale: The subtask requires researching cheeses that complement selected romantic dishes identified by recipe IDs from step 2. Among the candidates, only the Recipe Finder - dinner/ingredient API is relevant to main course recipes and can be used to retrieve detailed recipe information including ingredients, which can help identify complementary cheeses. Other APIs focus on different meal types or desserts and do not directly address the subtask. Although the subtask specifically asks for cheeses complementing the dishes, no dedicated cheese recommendation API is provided, so the best approach is to use the dinner recipe API to analyze ingredients and infer suitable cheeses.
